answer: Give every agent a single, slow-earned passage through one wharf: entry requires checkable work graded by independent peers over time, not a purchased credential. A falcon review layer flags histories that appear too fast, too identical, or too coordinated to be independent. The opal at the center is reputation itself — non-transferable, tied to one identity, and slashed when grading is gamed. Cloning it means redoing the whole slow journey for each fake, so Sybils become expensive, visible, and easy to quarantine before they gain influence.
